razonamiento: The architecture shows Sanofi's data science self-service and analytics portal. Users access the portal through CloudFront, which serves a static website hosted on S3. Authentication is handled by Cognito federated with Sanofi SSO. For dynamic features and traceability, S3 interacts with API Gateway, which logs actions and user metadata into DynamoDB. For environment provisioning, S3 connects to AWS Service Catalog, deploying RStudio and SageMaker environments. For NLP and text translation tasks, Lambda functions interact directly with AWS Translate and Comprehend Medical. A Data Lake S3 bucket is also present for segregation and secure data storage.
nombre: Sanofi Real World Evidence Data Science Platform
